data.headline: CNERGY gets green light to export 30,000 tonnes of FO:
data.summary: Ogra has given permission to CNERGY to export 30,000 MT of FO.

data.headline: Cnergyico to export 60,000 tonnes of furnace oil:
data.summary: Cnergyico Pk Limited (CPL) will export 60,000 MT of furnace oil this month, following recent exports by two other refineries.

data.headline: Cnergyico to halt refinery operations amid petroleum glut
data.summary: CNERGY announced a temporarily shut down of its refinery, citing a massive buildup of high-speed diesel and petrol stocks.

data.headline: Cnergyico likely to ink plant upgrade deal soon
data.summary: Cnergyico PK, formerly known as Byco Petroleum, the largest oil refinery in Pakistan, has announced that it may sign a “final agreement” with the government soon to upgrade its both refineries under the amended Pakistan Oil Refining Policy for Up-gradation of Existing/ Brownfield Refineries, 2023.

data.headline: Oil refining sector sees USD 1bn investment boost
data.summary: Cnergyico Pk Limited, the country’s largest refiner, is eyeing more than USD 1bn in investment following the introduction of a new government policy aimed at stimulating the industry.

data.headline: Refinery seeks settlement deal with govt
data.summary: The Finance Division has asked refiner Cnergyico Pk Limited (CPL) to provide bank guarantees to settle an outstanding amount of PKR 47.5bn in petroleum levy (PL) on petroleum products, an official document showed.
